open_points.subject: authenticate_staff and change_staff_status
open_points.text: - authenticate_staff: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST normalize email, accept only an account whose status is StaffStatus.ACTIVE with a matching password, deciding nothing on email_verified_at, issue a hashed fixed-expiry session, audit success or concealed failure, and never reveal which check failed.
open_points.other_text: - change_staff_status: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST carry the change on a replacement account instance holding the new status and the captured updated_at, leaving staff_id, email, password_hash, role, created_at and created_by at their persisted values, because persisted records are frozen and assigning to a record that was read is forbidden. A transition into active from pending_verification MUST also record email_verified_at at that same captured timestamp: while the self-service verification challenge has no storage, the administrator performing the activation is what vouches for the address, and an account left unverified could never authenticate. A transition into active from suspended MUST leave email_verified_at exactly as persisted.
open_points.question: Must authenticate_staff ignore email_verified_at, or is an unverified account forbidden from authenticating?

open_points.subject: resolve_staff_session and change_staff_status
open_points.text: - resolve_staff_session: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST parse the R17 selector, verify its secret hash, fixed expiry, revocation and that the account status is StaffStatus.ACTIVE before returning StaffActorContext, deciding nothing on email_verified_at; any failure raises AuthenticationRejected.
open_points.other_text: - change_staff_status: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST carry the change on a replacement account instance holding the new status and the captured updated_at, leaving staff_id, email, password_hash, role, created_at and created_by at their persisted values, because persisted records are frozen and assigning to a record that was read is forbidden. A transition into active from pending_verification MUST also record email_verified_at at that same captured timestamp: while the self-service verification challenge has no storage, the administrator performing the activation is what vouches for the address, and an account left unverified could never authenticate. A transition into active from suspended MUST leave email_verified_at exactly as persisted.
open_points.question: Must resolve_staff_session ignore email_verified_at, or must an unverified account be unable to authenticate through session resolution?
